PS4 Gaming Lounge

Bring the lounge to the screen.

Project fee₹4,000

The PS4 Gaming Lounge website gives visitors a feel for the Thanjavur venue, then brings its games, offers, tournaments, food and booking information into one vivid experience.

The venue
Gaming in Thanjavur
The experience
Consoles, VR and racing
The journey
Explore, compare, enquire

Built for ₹4,000.

The PS4 Gaming Lounge website was delivered for ₹4,000. It brings the venue’s atmosphere, games, offers, pricing and booking information together in one place.

Let visitors picture the visit.

The site presents the lounge through a visual opening, game information and a gallery of the space. PS5, PS4, Xbox, VR and racing simulators are introduced as parts of the venue’s experience, alongside food from Crave.

A visitor can browse what is available, look through offers and tournaments, and find pricing and booking information within the same website. The structure keeps the excitement of the venue connected to the practical details of planning a visit.

Give every detail a route back to the visit.

Games, food, gallery images, reviews and contact information each answer a different visitor question. They are organised as parts of a single browsing journey, so a promising image can lead into a game choice, an offer or a booking enquiry.

A public home for the lounge.

The delivered experience brings the venue’s atmosphere and useful information together. It gives the business one place to point new visitors, with a clear path from discovery to contact.
